method: 43 main-run captures inspected through loaded contact sheets, including native desktop/mobile stage reopens; 8 final source-link/provenance captures opened directly at native size. Captures absent from reviewedLabels are retained as automated-run evidence without a manual-review claim.
observations: The three V10 costumes show complete silhouettes in selection and combat captures in both viewports. Their gallery images retain heads/horns, tails and feet within the visible image.
The nine new gallery illustrations are visible without observed stretching or a solid opaque cutout background. The three prop silhouettes and the three reserve character bases are complete.

Both backgrounds keep their native aspect ratios. The console/candelabrum and snowglobe remain at the documented source positions in the initial and post-movement images; numeric anchoring and shared-parallax checks in the preserved run also passed.

Crymini is explicitly labelled MODÈLE HISTORIQUE · 2017. The supplemental native captures show the entire note saying this concept predates the series and does not establish a current-season appearance.
Each of the three costume entries renders its three qualified official links, with legible text in both viewports; the supplemental browser measurements confirm their exact href values.
nonBlockingObservations: At 390×844 the closed native costume selects truncate long option labels. Adjacent descriptions identify the costume and episode; no control overlap was observed.
The contain-sized wide backgrounds leave a solid-color band above the artwork in the tall mobile arena, and side bands on desktop. This preserves the complete background framing.

Full-page screenshots show only their captured viewport. Long descriptions are read by scrolling; the eight supplemental images intentionally isolate the reference lists and the complete Crymini note.
limits: This visual review covers the listed capture pixels and observed states, not a physical mobile device, every camera boundary or all historical game content.
Still images do not certify animation timing. The separate recorded keyboard/touch samples establish that the same static costume source was retained during the sampled actions.
Reference link rendering was verified locally; the linked external pages were not opened during the supplement, and current remote availability is outside this browser check.
No exact canonical fidelity or exhaustive per-pixel alpha certification is inferred from these browser screenshots.
